approvals.czmq_assertion_policy: Approved by user 2026-10-06: Approve the CZMQ assertion policy.
approvals.unlinked_vendor_diagnostics: Approved by user 2026-10-06: Allow these unlinked vendor diagnostics.
approvals.exhaustive_enum_diagnostic: Approved by user 2026-10-06: Allow this exact enum diagnostic.

root_causes.czmq_assertion_policy: Pinned CZMQ zhashx.c executes s_zhashx_rehash inside assert at insertion and lookup. NDEBUG removes required resizing: 10000 keys leave 3 buckets. Retaining assertions grows to 16349 buckets. Unix static archives reuse czmq_objects; compile policy must apply there, while Apple/MSVC compile directly in czmq-static.
root_causes.unlinked_vendor_diagnostics: ziflist.c passes unsigned-char MAC text to snprintf. zosc.c uses pointer type-punning for float encoding/decoding and overlapping sprintf source/destination. These are upstream source defects. Exact final debuginfo for all three distributions proves zero zosc/ziflist symbols, while used Qore and CZMQ symbols are present. Their archive objects are not linked into shipped modules.
root_causes.exhaustive_enum_diagnostic: GCC includes an out-of-range enum path despite the private option map containing only the six declared types and getOption handling every one. A matching six-case control reproduces the warning and passes 60000 cases with zero Valgrind errors or lost allocations.

proposed_policy: Retain assertion expressions only in the private CZMQ compilation. Keep optimization and normal release flags for Qore and libzmq. No warning suppression.
tradeoff: CZMQ internal invariant checks remain active in optimized builds and may abort if their invariants are violated; required operations no longer disappear.
